backup.intro: The data of this LibreFolio in one archive, to keep somewhere safe or to move to another installation.

download.title: Back up the instance
download.description: One archive with the database, the uploaded files, the broker reports and the risk scenarios. The logs and the instance key are not included.
download.privacy: The archive holds every user's data and is not encrypted: store it somewhere private.
download.retention: The archive stays on the server for one hour, then it is deleted.
download.warningsTitle: The backup is complete, with warnings

warnings.database_integrity: The database failed its integrity check: it was archived as it is.
warnings.foreign_key_violations: The database has broken references between tables: it was archived as it is.
warnings.files_skipped: Some files were left out: links, special files, files or folders that could not be read, or files removed during the backup.

errors.backup_busy: Another backup is running: try again when it ends.
errors.backup_no_space: Not enough free space on the server for the backup.
errors.backup_folder_unusable: The backups folder on the server is a link or a file: LibreFolio builds backups only in a plain folder of its data directory.
errors.backup_failed: The backup failed: the server log has the details.
errors.backup_interrupted: The backup was interrupted, for example by a restart: create a new one.
errors.backup_job_not_found: This backup is no longer on the server: create a new one.
errors.network: The server could not be reached.
errors.unexpected: The server answered with an error: reload the page and try again.

toast.warnings: Backup ready, with warnings: check them before you rely on it.
